title_zh: 三处重点区节点级概念计划
author: 许丙南
boundary_note: Node carriers are relational design interfaces, not official parcels, red lines, construction drawings or entitlement claims.

nodes.gate: Confirm river, flood-control, traffic, ownership and fire constraints before any pilot.
nodes.acceptance_test: A resident can cross, rest, read the status and leave without an account; a robot can stop without blocking the accessible chain.

nodes.gate: Confirm campus/parcel access, heritage, displacement risk and operating consent before fit-out.
nodes.acceptance_test: A contribution can be attributed or withdrawn; an older resident can use the route and service without the digital layer.

nodes.gate: Confirm station, road, fire, crowd, retail and emergency-management constraints before an event window.
nodes.acceptance_test: Event capacity can drop to zero, the resident route remains open and the space returns to ordinary use within the declared recovery window.
